Metadata.title: Shahbaz Dental Clinic | Samundri
Metadata.description: Explore dental services and book an appointment with Shahbaz Dental Clinic in Samundri.

Home.title: A clearer path to a healthier smile
Home.description: Explore everyday dental care and book an appointment through a clear process designed around comfort, clarity, and respect.
Home.demoDescription: Explore services, choose a dentist, and reserve an available appointment time online.
Home.servicesDescription: Browse common reasons people visit a dentist. A clinician must assess you before recommending treatment.
Home.dentistsDescription: Choose a dentist based on care focus, languages, and scheduled availability.
Home.careDescription: Our booking experience keeps choices clear and collects only the information needed for your visit.
Home.careOneDescription: Begin with your concern and the questions that matter to you.
Home.careTwoDescription: Use plain language for options, preparation, and next steps.
Home.careThreeDescription: Keep personal details out of public pages and collect only what is needed.
Home.hygieneDescription: Patient safety, clean treatment areas, and careful instrument handling are part of each visit.
Home.stepsTitle: From choice to confirmation in six short steps
Home.locationDescription: Contact the clinic for the exact street address and directions.
Home.urgentTitle: This website is not an emergency-response service
Home.urgentDescription: For severe bleeding, facial swelling that affects breathing, major injury, or another serious emergency, seek appropriate local emergency care now.
Home.finalDescription: Choose an available dentist and time, then receive your confirmed appointment reference.

Services.title: Dental care, explained simply
Services.description: Explore common dental services. This information is general and is not a diagnosis.
Services.demoDescription: Select a service to see available dentists, dates, and appointment times.
Services.disclaimerDescription: A dentist must assess your individual needs before recommending care. Results and appointment length can vary.
Services.closingDescription: Choose Dental consultation and select No preference if you would like the first available dentist.

Dentists.title: Choose the right dentist for your visit
Dentists.description: Learn about each dentist's care focus, languages, and regular working days.
Dentists.demoDescription: Appointment availability is based on the schedules currently opened by the clinic.
Dentists.noPreferenceDescription: Choose No preference and we will match you with an available dentist.

Booking.title: Book an appointment
Booking.description: Choose an available date and time to create a confirmed clinic appointment.
Booking.demoDescription: Your selected time is reserved after successful submission. Keep your appointment reference for future changes.
Booking.serviceHelp: Select the service that best matches the kind of visit you want to discuss.
Booking.dentistHelp: Choose a dentist or let the clinic assign an available dentist.
Booking.noPreferenceDescription: Match me with an eligible available dentist
Booking.timeHelp: Select a date to load the clinic's current available times.
Booking.noSlots: No appointment times are available for this selection.
Booking.availabilityFailed: Availability could not be loaded. Please try again.
Booking.detailsHelp: Enter the contact details the clinic should use for this appointment.
Booking.reviewHelp: Check your details carefully. Submission immediately reserves the selected time.
Booking.consent: I consent to Shahbaz Dental Clinic storing these details to create and manage my appointment.
Booking.requiredDentist: Choose a dentist or No preference to continue.
Booking.requiredMobile: Enter a valid Pakistani mobile number.
Booking.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address or leave it blank.
Booking.requiredConsent: Consent is required to create the appointment.
Booking.slotUnavailable: That time was just booked. Please choose another available time.
Booking.bookingFailed: The appointment could not be created. Please try again.
Booking.confirmationDescription: Your selected time has been reserved. If you supplied an email, a confirmation message will be sent shortly.

Footer.summary: Bilingual dental care and online appointment booking for the Samundri community.
Footer.demonstration: Appointments are confirmed from the clinic's currently available schedule.
